threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's normal to pay for the Dalston Junction toilet. Locals know it's a surprise entry fee that adds to the charm!
Caught a bloke on the 59 last night singing opera at the top of his lungs. Whole bus was in stitches, except a guy in the back who looked like he was plotting his escape.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh döner mingling with the sound of street musicians outside the U-Bahn station on a Saturday afternoon hit me. This is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand that doubles as an open-air gallery, showcasing local artists' work between the sausages.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ability to seamlessly navigate BART delays and still show up at Dolores Park with takeout from La Taqueria, smiling.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, a guy tried to sell a cat on the 31 while belting out opera. The cat was unimpressed, but the whole bus stopped to hear him out.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think all siestas happen in the afternoon. But in Gràcia, many locals take a bite out before their evening plans, too.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the 8-minute wait for a tram after 10 PM; locals just know to switch to the night bus.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the Tube instead of the Overground—dead giveaway you're not from around here.
Heard a bloke on the N63 arguing with a pigeon last night. Said it was the only one that wouldn't judge him. Classic Peckham vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I noticed my favorite café started serving Turkish coffee alongside vegan pastries—now that’s a blend you only find in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous street vendor selling fresh currywurst with homemade vegan sauce at 3 AM after a night out.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to carry an umbrella in their bag but still leave it closed—just in case the sun comes out between fog spells.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the 19 bus. He was just casually scrolling his phone, like it was the most normal thing to do in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals meet at Plaça del Sol, but many prefer the quietude of the hidden squares like Viaducte de Vallcarca to avoid the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking pictures of the building façades, not realizing they’re just a prelude to losing a shoe on the cobblestones.
